label: Add the setting that makes a mute a Discord timeout when its duration fits one
summary: Adds column "mute_timeout" to "GuildModeration" when it does not have it

execute.description: add the column, on for the guilds that are there, so their timeouts stay timeouts
execute.sql: ALTER TABLE "public"."GuildModeration" ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "mute_timeout" bool NOT NULL DEFAULT true

postcheck.sql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'GuildModeration' AND column_name = 'mute_timeout') AS "result"

label: Make the Timeout of the auto-moderation rules a Mute
summary: Sets "hard_action" and the actions of "escalation" from Timeout to Mute

execute.description: make the hard actions a Mute
make the steps of the escalations a Mute, in their order
execute.sql: UPDATE "public"."GuildAutoModerationRule" SET "escalation" = (SELECT jsonb_agg(CASE WHEN "step"->>'action' = 'Timeout' THEN jsonb_set("step", '{action}', '"Mute"') ELSE "step" END ORDER BY "position") FROM jsonb_array_elements("escalation") WITH ORDINALITY AS "steps"("step", "position")) WHERE jsonb_typeof("escalation") = 'array' AND "escalation" @> '[{"action":"Timeout"}]'::jsonb

postcheck.description: verify no rule takes a Timeout
postcheck.sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "public"."GuildAutoModerationRule" WHERE "hard_action" = 'Timeout' OR (jsonb_typeof("escalation") = 'array' AND "escalation" @> '[{"action":"Timeout"}]'::jsonb)) AS "result"

label: Make the Timeout of the thresholds of warnings a Mute

postcheck.description: verify no threshold takes a Timeout
postcheck.sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "public"."GuildWarnThreshold" WHERE "action" = 'Timeout') AS "result"
